summary: Iter24 SMS-test endpoint verification — POST /api/integrations/sms/test. Wrote dedicated test file (tests/test_iter24_sms_test_endpoint.py) with 8 tests covering auth matrix (401 unauth, 403 employee), input validation (missing 'to' → 422, malformed '12345' → 422 with E.164 message, body>320 → 422), and live happy path (Twilio configured check, explicit body send, default-body send). All 8 tests PASS. Both live sends produced SIDs matching ^SM[0-9a-f]{32}$ with status queued/sent. Audit log rows for action='sms_test_send' verified in db.audit_logs (note: collection is plural audit_logs, request mentioned audit_log singular — actual code at core.py:182 writes to audit_logs). Ran iter12 regression suite — 9/9 PASS. Verified payroll/runs/{rid}/send-sms?dry_run=true → returns plan with 5 would_send + 1 skipped (missing phone) + twilio_configured=true; sms_logs collection got 6 corresponding entries for the run. Backend supervisor RUNNING, ruff lint clean.

minor.issue: Documentation drift: review request says audit row goes to db.audit_log (singular), actual code writes to db.audit_logs (plural via core.audit()). Tests adapted to match real collection name. No functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/integrations.py — SmsTestIn correctly bounds body to 320 chars via Field(max_length=320); Pydantic returns 422 cleanly. 'to' is a free-form str (not constr) — runtime validation deferred to normalize_phone(), which is fine and returns a helpful 422 mentioning E.164.
Endpoint correctly short-circuits with 503 when Twilio unconfigured (not currently exercised since creds are live, but logic is sound).
Endpoint properly maps Twilio failure → 502 with reason. Good error UX.
Default body templating uses user.get('email', 'admin') — safe against missing field. Includes admin email in audit_logs meta for traceability.

is_configured()/normalize_phone() are imported at module-load — fine because sms.py reads env at import and the .env is already loaded by uvicorn before routers register. No regression risk from the new endpoint addition.
sms_test_send audit row stores {to, ok, sid} — sufficient for forensic queries. Recipient PII (phone) is intentional here for an admin-only smoke endpoint.

(Pre-existing, non-blocking) sms.py reads ACCOUNT_SID/AUTH_TOKEN/FROM_NUMBER as module-level constants at import — if creds rotate at runtime without backend restart, is_configured() will not pick up the change. Acceptable for current deployment model.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 new + 9/9 iter12 regression + payroll dry_run smoke)
